newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Petroleum looking to Aust oil sector.
newsitem.headline: NZ Petroleum looking to Aust oil sector.

text.p: New Zealand Petroleum, which has become a portfolio investor in the resource sector, is assessing opportunities in the Australian oil and gas sector, the company said in a statement released by the New Zealand Stock Exchange on Monday.
Chairman Stuart Cairns told NZ Petroleum's annual meeting on Friday the company had had a slower start to the current year than expected and the share market was volatile.

However, the directors had been advised by Ross Asset Management, manager of the company's portfolio, that it presently saw no reason to downgrade the NZ$650,000 total gross income forecast for the 1997 year.

Shareholders approved the adoption of a new constitution; a 1:10 distribution to shares held in Triton Oil (NZ) and an issue to directors of 1.6 million options to acquire convertible notes prior to the conversion date of the notes at June 30, 1988.
The former Triton Oil (NZ) would be renamed NZ Petroleum Exploration and directors hoped to see this company become a direct explorer in oil and gas exploration.
